stem: An analyst adds the summer clearance of last year's TV models, which Voltmarkt sold at permanent markdown prices, to the TV category's promotion revenue. What does this do to the TV promo share of sales?

options.text: It leaves the share unchanged, since markdown revenue is already in the total
It overstates the share, since clearance markdowns are not promotions
It understates the share, since markdown revenue shrinks the total
It is correct, since any price below list counts as a promotion
